Still open: no Pin Column anywhere; the 48 px minimum hides the header label and in Clip Text dates spill into the next column; the rail shows Tasks/Calls/Meetings counts only for All open, Due today and Overdue; items 1, 2, 13 declined by the developer.

tickets.title: Work Queue | Filter offers only Status and Priority — every other layout field is unavailable
tickets.dev: Priority labels mapped to Low/Normal/High/Highest; Created By / Modified By added.
tickets.summary: Priority values read Low / Normal / High / Highest; High returns exactly t01, t03, t06. Created By and Modified By are in the field list and work (me → 8, ndc-staging-owner → 0).

tickets.title: Workqueue | Lookup and Multi-Select Lookup fields offer a plain text field in Create Queue › Categorization
tickets.dev: Record picker; module picker on its own line so nothing overlaps − / +.
tickets.summary: Lookup gives a single-record picker, Multi-Select Lookup takes several records; no overlap with − / + at 1280 or 1024 px. Operators are Equals / Not equal / empty / not empty (lookup) and Contains any of / none of / empty / not empty (multi) — the ticket also listed contains/starts/ends (INFO).

tickets.title: Custom Views | ?view= with a deleted or foreign view ID falls back to the last-used view instead of All Leads
tickets.dev: Deleted / foreign / other-layout ?view now opens All <Module> with the toast "That view is no longer available. Showing All Leads."
tickets.devHeld: Only when the last-used view is not applicable; otherwise the last-used view opens under a toast that says All Leads.
tickets.summary: With the last-used view "QA RT 2098 last", ?view=<deleted id> and ?view=<test user 2 private view> show the toast "That view is no longer available. Showing All Leads." and remove ?view, but the page opens QA RT 2098 last (2 records), not All Leads. With a last-used view from another layout it lands on All Leads. Nothing of the foreign view leaks.
still: ?view=<deleted ff0a79b9…> with last-used QA RT 2098 last → shows QA RT 2098 last (2 records); expected All Leads.
Toast text says "Showing All Leads." while another view is shown.

tickets.title: Custom Views | Lookup criteria in the view editor take free text only (no record picker)
tickets.dev: Overlap fixed — same change as NDC-1837.
tickets.summary: View editor lookup rows use a module picker + record picker (single keeps one record, multi keeps several); nothing overlaps − / + at 1280, 1024 or 800 px. Saved criteria store "<module>:<record id>", and equals / not equal / empty / not empty / any-of return exactly the seeded leads.

tickets.title: Custom Views | Deleted criteria field: field used by a view can be deleted
tickets.dev: A field used in a view's criteria can no longer be deleted; the refusal names the views.
tickets.summary: Layout builder dialog lists "QA RT 2106 crit" and disables Delete Permanently; API DELETE → 409 naming the view; a column-only view does not block. After the condition was changed the delete returned 204. INFO: wording points to Automation / Process Management and the code is FIELD_IN_USE_BY_WORKFLOW.

tickets.title: Custom Views | Kanban "Unaccounted" — cards can be moved into it
tickets.dev: "Unaccounted" is source-only: drag out allowed, drag in refused.
tickets.devHeld: Drag out held; drag in refused except the first drop after load.
tickets.summary: Dragging from Unaccounted to Proposal moves the deal and sets stage = proposal. Dragging into Unaccounted dims the column and is refused — but the first drop after the board loads (while Unaccounted holds a card) lands the card in the neighbouring Closed_lost column and opens "Verify details — before closing this deal" (3/3 runs). Cancel restores it.
still: First drop on Unaccounted after load: card shown in Closed_lost + close-deal dialog; expected refused with no move.

tickets.title: Workqueue | Applied filters don't persist on refresh/next session (new login)
tickets.dev: Saved filter restored after the full field list loads.
tickets.summary: Priority = High survives 4 reloads and a fresh sign-in; period switches keep it and return the expected rows; Clear filters stays cleared after reload.

tickets.title: Custom Views | View name validation messages are never shown
tickets.dev: Messages for empty name, 120-character limit and duplicate.
tickets.summary: Empty / spaces-only → "Enter a name for the view." with Save disabled; 120 chars → limit message, 121st char cut; duplicate → "You already have a view with this name."; API 409 / 422. INFO: uniqueness is per layout, so an API view without layout and a UI view can share a name.

tickets.title: Custom Views | Pick list value used by a view can be removed
tickets.dev: Removing a pick-list option used by a view is refused, naming the views (server).
tickets.summary: Removing or renaming an option a view filters on (any case, single value or any-of list) → 409 naming the views, in the API and as a toast in the layout builder; an unused option and the option after the view changed are removed (200). INFO: a green "Field updated successfully" toast shows next to the error.

tickets.title: Custom Views | Upper-case 'AND' pattern is accepted by the editor and the API
tickets.dev: Edit Pattern lower-cases as you type; API-saved upper case opens lower-cased; per-row toggle declined.
tickets.devHeld: Editor part held. API still accepts and stores upper/mixed case; summary shows it as stored.
tickets.summary: Editor: typing AND/OR becomes and/or and saves lower case. API: "1 And 2", "1 OR 2", "1 AND 2" → 201 and stored as sent; results identical to lower case. The ticket expected the API to reject upper case. Product decision (25 Oct): the criteria pattern must not be editable by typing — and/or should only be switched by clicking the AND/OR toggle between rows.
still: API accepts upper/mixed case (201) — ticket expected 400/422.
Requested change: disable typing in the criteria pattern; switch and/or only by clicking the AND/OR button.

tickets.summary: Through Manage columns on Contacts: after ov-01…ov-51, 50 kept and only ov-01 dropped; after re-saving ov-02 and saving ov-52, ov-03 dropped and ov-02 kept.
